title: Normalized realization of any specified native support tower
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $D$ a finite-field datum with $\ell\ne D.p$, and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $D.k$-schemes. Fix a compactification $c$, a reduction calculus $S$ of [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], and a constructible completed-integral object $K$ as in [lem-coef-compact-support-normalized-realization]. There exists a realization $R$ with exactly the levels, complex identifications and transition equations of that node, and its normalized underlying tower is equal to $(\operatorname{scalarSupportCompletedTower}_{E,c,S})(K)$ of [def-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-maps]. The equality retains the prescribed native system at every positive exponent.

proof.text: Use the native system transition formula and input reduction compatibility to identify its finite transition with coefCompactSupportNormalizedTau. The finite-action normalization makes its exact completed restriction a normalized DVR tower.

Represent the native coefficient sequence by a complex. Exact evaluation gives its finite complexes and chain maps; exact scalar restriction gives its completed strict tower. Derived transition factorization proves the finite equations, and restrictedTransition proves the completed equation degree by degree. Its tower is the native restriction by construction.

theorem compactSupport_native_realization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (hK : sfIntegralConstructible l E X K) :
    ∃ R : CoefCompactSupportRealization l E D hl c K,
      CoefCompactSupportRealizationSpec l E D hl c K R ∧
      R.normalized.tower = (PurStrictScalar.scalarSupportCompletedTower l E c S).obj K
